items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 June 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 01 June 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of the British Isles as various frontal zones affect the area.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the south at times, decreasing 2 to 4 later this evening, becoming variable in places later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle as well as areas of mist, with isolated fog patches.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor and falling very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south later.


##Weather##

Showery outbreaks of rain soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.
